product_one_liner.value: Abacus.AI provides an AI assistant and agent platform that lets professionals, teams and enterprises build apps, analyze information and automate work using multiple AI models.

employee_band.notes: Based on the profile’s reported 288 employees; its separate company-size label says 51–200, so the source is internally inconsistent.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts explain model-training methodology and inference/deployment engineering; authors include Lokesh Reddy, Balajee Sambasivam and CTO Arvind Sundararajan.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes SDK, API, connectors, authentication, tutorials and help articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists Research Scientist and Software Engineer – Generative AI, with application instructions.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the company’s public compliance claims, not independent verification of certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly recorded round is October 27, 2021, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists Junior Sales Development Representative (Jr SDR).

launched_6mo.notes: Smaug-Humanizer was released October 26, 2026; Smaug-Decisions and Smaug-Audio-Decisions-0.7B were announced November 2, 2026, within the requested window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated external C-level/VP arrival or departure was verified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.
